I only wish I could protect her as she grows.''|Lingfang, [[Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled]]}} '''Lingfang''' {{Lang|zh=铃坊}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears during {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}. ==History== Lingfang grew up with her father, who served in Mengzhou's [[Ministry of War]] and taught her how to fight from when she was young until she grew bored of it after a few years and ran away to study music. She was childhood friends with [[Ruoyun]], and attended the Waking Moon festival with [[Qingxiao]] and [[Ruoyun]] before the Fortress and Gorges War. During her years wandering, she met a painter who loved to paint [[Xuanling Bird]]s. The two eventually became married and had a daughter together and lived happily until her husband was killed by [[Tacet Discord]]s. Following the death of her husband, Lingfang sold her {{w|liuqin}}, swearing to get revenge for her husband, and took up the sword once again to fight as a soldier in the [[Fortress and Gorges War]]. During the war, Lingfang and her comrades fell in battle, and [[Muyu]] trapped their [[reverberation]]s, forcing them under his control and rendering them unable to pass on. Lingfang and her comrades remained trapped under Muyu's control until roughly 200 years later when [[Yangyang]] uses the [[Song of Xuanling]] to free them. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Lingfang |zhs = 铃坊 |zht = 鈴坊 |ja = 鈴坊 |ko = 영방 |fr = Lingfang |de = Lingfang |es = Lingfang |th = Lingfang |pt = Lingfang }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.5}} ==References== {{Reflist}}
